kwargs.prompt: Build co-play graph → phi_rank via PageRank (numpy, no torch)
kwargs.thinking: Sorted play_stats by last_played timestamp, built undirected weighted adjacency where tracks within SESSION_WINDOW=8 positional steps get edges (weight = proximity × geometric-mean completion quality). Power-iteration PageRank (d=0.85, 50 iter) over the graph, min-max normalised to [0.10, 1.00]. Written as phi_rank annotation at session restore via maybe_rank_and_annotate() in _restore_annotations_worker. Dangling nodes handled by uniform teleport. Caps at 2000 most recent played tracks to bound matrix size. Checkpoint ~/.phi/coplay_rank.json.
